northStar: Cast workshop dispatch floor: one unnumbered carved original versus identical numbered casts under hard raking light on graphite slate.

motion.name: raking-light
motion.value: scroll-driven background-position on .cast-row::after and .studio::after; JS --rake fallback
motion.purpose: Light sweeps the cast rank and plinth as the visitor scrolls.

motion.name: run-calliper
motion.purpose: Latest run is lit; any run sets the calliper reading.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All motion stops; final light position and values render immediately.

rules: Headline number is live stencil type from the CSV, not a raster plate.
Plaster white is the only bright.
Whole casts only — drop units on small screens, never crop one.
Chart holds only Einstein and the line; identical-copy metaphor lives in the cast rank and labels.
Every number from tracker/data CSVs via build.py.
